profile.description: Active mounted-shooting competition at Polson Fairgrounds, but the organizer says spectator traffic is too small to make Adventure Zone worthwhile.

notes.subject: Low spectator volume makes event a poor fit
notes.body: Rick Farnsworth replied Aug. 5, 2026 that they would not have much for spectators or a crowd and he did not think Adventure Zone would be worthwhile. Current Polson Fairgrounds and CMSA listings confirm the event is real and active Sept. 10-13, 2026. The issue is event economics/attendance rather than contact failure. Do not routinely re-pursue unless the event grows or its public-attendance format changes.
